summary: TH International Ltd filed a 6-K covering Q1 2026 results and disclosed a definitive agreement with THRI to issue up to US$55.0 million of additional senior secured convertible notes. Terms: up to $55 million aggregate principal, senior secured convertible notes. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation stated. The notes are issued by the company to a related party (brand owner/founding shareholder). Mechanics involve secured convertible debt, likely with conversion terms to be detailed. Watch for expansion funding and potential dilution risk.
